description: Visa has launched USDC-based commercial funding for cross-border payouts through its Visa Direct service, with Inyo Global serving as its partner. The offering follows successful testing in 2025 and allows eligible businesses to prefund international payments using USDC. Availability will depend on customer eligibility and geographic restrictions, and Visa has not confirmed that the service covers all markets supported by Inyo.
title: Visa Enables Round-the-Clock USDC Funding for Global Payments

description: Smartphones sold globally are primarily powered by two companies — MediaTek and Qualcomm. The latter’s Snapdragon lineup is pretty vast, from budget devices to flagship offerings. These include the mid-range category, where buyers can find high-refresh-rate displays, large batteries, and capable camera hardware without spending more than Rs. 30,000. Brands like Realme, Vivo, OnePlus, Oppo, and Lava cater to different needs, from everyday performance and gaming to battery life and fast charging.
title: Best Smartphones under Rs. 30,000 with MediaTek SoC

description: WhatsApp has an easy and convenient tool baked into the app that helps users export chats. The built-in tool works on Android and iOS, with users able to import chat with a few simple steps. Here’s how you can go about exporting chats from WhatsApp on your smartphone.
title: How to Export a WhatsApp Chat on Android and iOS: A Step-by-Step Guide
